{{Top}}
{{Youmay|anomaly in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] that could be sensed by [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]]|a [[Force void/Legends|void in the Force]], living beings that could not be sensed through the Force, or a [[Wound in the Force/Legends|wound in the Force]], a type of disturbance in the Force that distorted and weakened the influence of the will of the Force}}
{{Citation}}
{{Quote|I sense a disturbance in the Force.''"<br />"''You ''always'' sense a disturbance in the Force. But yeah&mdash;I sense it too.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Kyle Katarn]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Palpatine_disturbance.jpg|thumb|right|220px|[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] perceives a disturbance in the Force.]]
A '''disturbance in the Force''', referred to as '''echoes in the Force''' by [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and former [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Kreia]], was an unusual fluctuation or anomaly in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] that could be sensed by [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]]. These disturbances could range in intensity from mild fluctuations to full-blown psychic trauma that would cause the individual to experience literal, physical pain and perhaps even mental shock.

==Types of disturbances==
{{Quote|'I felt a great disturbance in the Force, as if millions of voices suddenly cried out in terror and were suddenly silenced.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], sensing the destruction of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
Every living being interacted with the Force in its unique way, sending ripples through it, allowing a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] to [[Force sense/Legends|feel]] one's presence in an area. Each person however interacted uniquelly with the Force, leaving their own signature disturbance that could be recogniseable by more powerful or experienced Force users. While fledgling Jedi [[Kyle Katarn]] could only vaguely discern some presence around him, Lord [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] could feel [[Yun]]'s presence thanks to the youngster's self-doubt.<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref> Years earlier, on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], [[Anakin_Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] felt [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'s presence who was hidden in the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]'' in [[Docking_Bay_327/Legends|Docking Bay 327]]; later, in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he felt that the Force was strong in a [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|certain Rebel pilot]].<ref name="Episode 4" />

[[Wound in the Force/Legends|Wounds]] in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] were the most easily recognizable form of disturbance. Such massive disturbances were created from the most catastrophic events of death and destruction. Force adepts could often feel such disturbances from across the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Darth Sidious had managed to trace Darth Maul and Savage Opress' location on Mandalore via a disturbance in the Force, resulting in him traveling to Mandalore to personally confront the two Sith Nightbrothers.

[[File:SkywalkerInCaveOfEvil-TESB.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Luke Skywalker felt massive dark side aura coming from the [[Cave of Evil/Legends|Dark Side Cave]] on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].]]
While death caused the greatest ripples in the Force, many other developments in the Force caused disturbances such as alignment shifts. One such disturbance was sensed by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] when he no longer felt the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] aura around the [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi Temple]] and, years earlier, when he felt great power coming from a [[Cave of Evil/Legends|cave]] during his training on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] sensed this when she passed through the place in orbit around Endor where [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had died. Luke and Mara Jade also sensed this in his former palace. In the aftermath of the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], Palpatine sensed a disturbance in the Force from Luke Skywalker's Jedi potential, and demanded that Darth Vader, who had also felt it, make contact with him on the matter.

The dark side of the Force often created disturbances&mdash;during the final years of the [[Mandalorian Wars]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Darth Malak|Malak]] felt great amounts of power coming from the inside of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakatan]] ruins on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], stating that "he could feel its power". Almost a decade later, [[Kreia]] felt the dark side aura emanating from [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and she refused to even set foot on the planet's surface when [[Meetra Surik]] traveled there.

[[File:Rebornpwned4.jpg|thumb|right|[[Kyle Katarn]] faces the [[Reborn]].]]
Disturbances in the Force caused by the dark side often had powerful effects on surrounding flora and fauna. When the Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Juhani]] briefly turned to the dark side, she drove the [[Kath hound/Legends|Kath hounds]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] mad&mdash;causing them to become extremely aggressive and violent. The fractured planet [[Malachor V]] was so corrupted with the dark side that it affected the life on its surface&mdash;namely, the [[Storm beast]]s. Another creature corrupted by the dark side was the [[Terentatek/Legends|Terentatek]]. The power and presence of the dark side gradually distorted their shapes and corrupted their minds. As a side effect, terentatek became virtually immune to the effects of the Force.

Other disturbances may occur during unnatural events in the Force. One such event occurred when [[Kyle Katarn]] first felt the power of the [[Reborn]] warriors. After his first duel with one of the Reborn, he remarked that his encounter with the warrior felt strange. He stated that the Reborn looked like a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and fought like a Jedi, but that his power felt warped. The Reborn and the [[Shadowtrooper]]s were [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] that had been artificially infused with the Force. As such, when a Force adept came near them, they could feel the abnormality of their power.
